description: Use this when the answer needs current or sourced information from the web: news, papers, people, posts on X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, Reddit and Hacker News discussions, patents, places, images or general queries. social: posts and videos with views, likes, comments and authors in metadata; name the platform in the query ("on tiktok", "instagram reels", "youtube videos", "on X") to search only there, otherwise X and the one platform likeliest to hold the answer are searched. community: what real people say on Reddit and Hacker News (r/<subreddit> in the query searches one subreddit; points, comment counts and authors in metadata). Returns ranked results (id, title, url, snippet) fused from several engines. Leave `mode` out and the server picks one from the query and reports its choice in routing.auto; it never picks `deep` and picks `social` only when the query names a platform (X, Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), so ask for those explicitly otherwise (they cost more). `providers` sets an engine preference. Do not use it to read a page you already have: use fetch. Each call is charged to the connected organisation's balance; the result states the charge.

providers.description: Optional engine preference. One name pins that engine; several are queried together and rank-fused.

name: search

error.description: A v1 error code, e.g. insufficient_credits, rate_limited, invalid_url.

id.description: The result's URL; pass it to fetch.

auto.description: Present when the server picked the mode: mode, source, reason.

title: Web search
